$comment: Quarantine for lab specimens that fail the #920 machine-played rungs while a
known defect is open. This is a ledger of debt, not a set of exemptions.
Two rules keep it from rotting into a permanent allowlist:
1. A quarantined specimen that STOPS failing also fails the gate. The entry
must be deleted when the defect is fixed; the gate will tell you.
2. Every entry names the open issue that will remove it. No issue, no entry.
Adding an entry is not a way to land a broken specimen. It exists so that one
team's open bug does not block every unrelated PR in the repository.
Measured on this machine against main e11c6276 on 2026-08-25.

a001_pong.reason: 8 formula errors: SCENE_EVENT kind 'run_hook' is silently dropped, so init_state never runs and every v.* binding is nil

a002_breakout.reason: 7 formula errors, same root cause as a001_pong: SCENE_EVENT kind 'run_hook' in on_enter. Regressed by #923 — this specimen previewed clean at ccc21834

b006_dialogue.reason: 2 formula errors: v.dialogueText and v.speakerName never set, same SCENE_EVENT kind family

b010_falling_blocks.reason: 1 formula error: on_enter sets 160 variables but never calls draw_board, so v.boardText is nil until the first update tick. Different cause from the others and a one-line fix

a002_breakout.reason: SCENE_EVENT kind 'run_hook' is inert, so init_state never runs and no game exists to win. Also authors no input script at all

b001_fishing.reason: crashes on its first frame reading `time` as a Lua global. Separately reads raw keyboard state via _G.love.keyboard.isDown, so no scripted input can drive it (#934)

b005_lockpicking.reason: crashes on its first frame reading `time` as a Lua global

b010_falling_blocks.reason: all nine of its SCENE_EVENT commands use kind 'custom', which scene_host silently drops, so update_tick never fires and no piece ever falls

d002_sokoban.reason: byte-equivalent copy of a004_sokoban (#918); same unreachable win
